model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", is on a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^0$ to $2^8$, with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is on a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 0.9. The plot shows that all four models exhibit an increasing trend in coverage as the number of completions increases. The Llama-3B model (blue line with circles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.45 and rises to about 0.9. The Llama-3B + FT model (green line with triangles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.48 and also rises to about 0.9. The Llama-1B model (light blue line with squares) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.35 and increases to about 0.85. The Llama-1B + FT model (light green line with inverted triangles) starts at a coverage of approximately 0.38 and increases to about 0.88. The Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT models consistently maintain higher coverage than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT models across the entire range of completions.
